::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_intents/{pi}"}
#docs
Returns the intent plus `attempts[]`, oldest first — the “Attempt 1 / Attempt 2 / …” history.

The intent carries the SAME joined context as a list row (customer, gateway account, card), and each attempt carries the instrument it was tried with — per attempt, because a declined buyer can retry on a different card. A voided intent also carries `voided_transaction`, the `payment_reversal` the release booked.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `pi` | `string` | **yes** | Payment intent id (pi_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `payment_intent`. One of `payment_intent`. |
| `id` | `string` | The payment intent's id (pi_…). |
| `status` | `string` | `voided` is set by the void route alongside `voided_at`. One of `inited`, `in_progress`, `authorized`, `consumed`, `expired`, `voided`. |
| `purpose` | `string` | Whether the intent takes a payment or saves a payment method. One of `payment`, `setup`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | Always 0 for a `setup` intent. |
| `max_amount_minor` | `integer` | The mandate ceiling this `setup` intent registered with, and what a retry re-registers with. Null for `payment` intents. |
| `currency` | `string` | The payment intent's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `attempt_count` | `integer` | Payment attempts — how many times this intent has been tried at the gateway. |
| `last_attempt_status` | `string` | Status of the NEWEST attempt. `status` above cannot express a refusal — there is no `failed` intent status, because a declined authorization leaves the intent OPEN so it can be retried — so this is what distinguishes a declined intent from one the buyer is still working through. `null` means no attempt has been made yet. One of `inited`, `requires_action`, `authorized`, `consumed`, `failed`, `voided`. |
| `next_action` | `object` | How the buyer completes the challenge, when one is outstanding. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the intent expires (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `voided_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the intent was voided (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment intent was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `customer_name` | `string` | The customer's first name. |
| `customer_first_name` | `string` | The Customer Information card is First/Last name, not a display name — and a display name cannot be split back into them. |
| `customer_last_name` | `string` | The customer's last name. |
| `customer_email` | `string` | The customer's email. |
| `customer_phone` | `string` | The customer's phone number. |
| `gateway_key` | `string` | The gateway that processes the payment. |
| `gateway_account` | `string` | A business can hold several accounts on one gateway (“Stripe / Stripe-1”), so the key alone names nothing. |
| `gateway_account_label` | `string` | The label of the gateway account. |
| `payment_method_brand` | `string` | The card brand used. |
| `payment_method_last4` | `string` | The last four digits of the card used. |
| `attempts` | `array of object` | The attempts made for this intent. |
| `voided_transaction` | `object` | The `payment_reversal` transaction the void booked, correlated by `transactions.payment_intent_id`. Null for every intent that was not voided. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such payment intent |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_intents/pi_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
